facts.fact: Brooks 是牧场的 engine guy，每周车辆保养日今天轮到 Ashton 当助手。
facts.anchor: Brooks is “the engine guy”—the one who fixes them all when they go wrong—so this task usually falls to him every week.

facts.fact: 偏头痛后三天首见——进车库头一小时他查岗不少于八次。
facts.anchor: He checked in with me no fewer than eight times in the first hour we were in the garage together.

facts.fact: 收工时他问曲奇模具用了没，她反邀两小时后来看。
facts.anchor: “You used those cookie cutters yet, Ash?”

facts.fact: 她的烘焙流水线：funfetti 造型饼在烤、柠檬凝乳现做、蓝莓曲奇、s’mores 待烤。
facts.anchor: my fun-shaped funfetti cookies were baking, I whipped up a batch of lemon curd

facts.fact: 蓝莓曲奇诀窍：鲜果而非冷冻冻干、先滚面粉再拌入湿料。
facts.anchor: The trick is to use fresh fruit, not frozen or freeze-dried

facts.fact: 他推门而入的许可来自她那句「门永远开着」——「我就知道不会锁」。
facts.anchor: “Exactly,” he says with a smug grin. “I knew it would be unlocked.”

facts.fact: 贴身时刻他先轻声确认她是否愿意。
facts.anchor: “You sure you’re okay with this?” he asks softly.

facts.fact: 他发现她的私处银环，把场景比作自助餐并称找到新宠。
facts.anchor: “My god, it’s an all-you-can-eat,” he whispers

facts.fact: 口技高潮后他贴着她打五星、宣布上主菜。
快感顶点她尝到颜色、闻到数字、听见形状——身心重建重接。
facts.anchor: In the moment of ecstasy, I taste color, I smell numbers, hear shapes.

facts.fact: 心跳跳成他名字的节奏：她现在属于他。
事后他铺好新床单、端来冷盘：每款曲奇各一块+奶酪葡萄莓果帕尔马火腿。
facts.anchor: One of each flavor of the cookies I baked—the ones I never got around to putting away—are lined up along one side of the tray.

facts.fact: 她先开口不对 Ev 说——话一出口就恨这个说谎版本的自己。
facts.anchor: “We’re not telling Ev about this, right?”

facts.fact: 她的预感：秘密从不通向好事、守秘终将以泪收场。
facts.anchor: Secrets never lead to good things. Keeping secrets will end in tears.

facts.fact: 他把奶酪按到她唇边——我们的小秘密 devil，你和我。
facts.anchor: “Our little secret, devil,” he says, gently pressing the cool food against my lips. “You and me.”

facts.fact: 她心里的旧禁令被驳回：不行？不该？去他的。想要。
